IN-HOUSE PIPELINE This section is not the Paraphase result itself. It comes from the in-house paralog2viewer RCCX module: Paraphase haplotypes and phasing are the input; gene type per haplotype is voted at the discriminating paralog sites (BLAST-derived); a haplotype Paraphase left unlinked is placed on the allele that lacks a distal (CYP21A2) end; modules are ordered 5' to 3' by type, and same-type neighbours stay unordered.
Tier: P and LP = ClinVar or InterVar Pathogenic or Likely pathogenic (the higher of the two); note = any other flag: known gene/pseudogene variant on a carrier haplotype of the functional gene; high impact (frameshift_variant, stop_gained, start_lost, splice_donor_variant, splice_acceptor_variant) with Max Allele Freq < 0.01; VUS with REVEL > 0.7 or CADD_phred > 25 and Max Allele Freq < 0.01. Missing Max Allele Freq counts as 0. Locus = role of the haplotype that carries the variant (gene, pseudogene, ...; unresolved if the haplotype could not be assigned). Counts are distinct variants per locus. Max 300 flagged rows per gene. CN: haplotypes resolved (two-copy haplotypes counted twice) vs Paraphase total_cn.
